title: Left to right, or the times sign first?
text: Division and multiplication are the same priority, so the left one happens first. A common mistake is to multiply $$3 \times 2$$ first and then divide 18 by 6. What is $$18 \div 3$$?

title: Then multiply
text: You now have $$6 \times 2$$. What is that product?

title: Worked solution
text: $$18 \div 3 \times 2 = 6 \times 2 = 12$$. Common mistake: treating the expression as $$18 \div (3 \times 2) = 3$$. General rule: multiplication and division are done left to right, not 'multiplication always before division.'
